title: Youthful Japanese Filo Pastry Samosas
description: A sweet and energizing Japanese dish featuring filo pastry, candy, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, with a jammy and shattering texture. This dish is perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the filo pastry and cut it into small squares.
Mix the crushed mochi candy, coconut sugar, sesame seeds, and cardamom powder in a bowl.
Place a small spoonful of the candy mixture onto the center of each filo pastry square.
Brush the edges of the pastry with melted ghee.
Fold the pastry into triangles and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the samosas with more melted ghee.
Bake the samosas for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the samosas warm with a scoop of green tea ice cream.
Sprinkle the tops with rice flour before serving.
